proposed_widenings.name: activated_persistent_on_hit_weapon_rider
proposed_widenings.justification: The current magic-item families can model passive bonuses and immediate activations, but not an activation that arms a weapon for a timed window and later discharges a save-gated rider on the next hit before expiring. That requires either a new ongoing-effect-capable non-spell family or a reshape that lets activated non-spell abilities host ongoing trigger operations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take a Bonus Action to magically coat the blade with poison. The poison remains for 1 minute or until an attack using this weapon hits a creature. That creature must succeed on a DC 15 Constitution saving throw or take 2d10 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition for 1 minute.

notes: The passive +1 attack-roll and damage-roll bonus fits the existing magic-item surface via passive grants scoped to this specific weapon. The blocker is only the activated poison-coating rider: it is neither an immediate activation nor a reaction, and current MagicItemMechanics has no honest way to represent a timed armed state that later opens an on-hit save gate. Dawn reset, fixed DC, poison damage, and the Poisoned condition already exist in the current surface.
